questions.question: First apply zoom_x_region(start=2024-01-01, end=2024-03-31). Then apply filter_lines(lines_to_remove=[Electronics, Home Appliances, Clothing, Beauty Products]). How do Sports and Books compare in revenue level and day-to-day jitter over Q1?

answer.value: Sports runs an order of magnitude above Books on revenue in that quarter—roughly a four-hundred-ish mean daily ticket versus mid-sixties for Books—so the Sports line rides much higher on the y-axis. Both still wiggle day to day, but Books stays in a narrower band while Sports shows wider swings, including occasional spikes toward the upper hundreds or nearly two thousand on strong days.

key_insights: Sports dominates Books on absolute revenue throughout Q1.
Sports carries almost all of the visible volatility; Books looks comparatively flat.

reasoning.reasoning: Locks the window to January–March 2024 for an apples-to-apples seasonal read.
Removes other product families so Sports and Books are directly comparable.
